title: Shoes

questions.question: Do you like buying shoes? How often?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I quite enjoy buying shoes, and I probably do it every couple of months. I like trying them on and finding a pair that both looks good and feels comfortable.

questions.question: Have you ever bought shoes online?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. A few months ago I bought a pair of running shoes on a shopping app. It was convenient and cheaper than in the shops, but I had to wait about a week for delivery.

questions.question: How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I usually spend a moderate amount, maybe a couple of hundred yuan per pair. I tend to look for good value, because I’d rather buy fewer but better pairs.

questions.question: Which do you prefer, fashionable or comfortable shoes?
questions.sampleAnswer: If I had to choose, I’d go with comfortable shoes, because I’m on my feet a lot during the day. Fashion matters, but a painful pair is not worth it.
